name: Dimitrios Pappas
bio:
Dimitrios's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Originally trained as a civil engineer, he found himself drawn to the intricate problem-solving involved in race strategy during a Formula SAE project in university. He quickly realized his passion lay in optimizing performance through data analysis and predictive modeling.

After graduating, Dimitrios transitioned into a junior strategist role at a small racing outfit, learning the ropes through long hours and a relentless pursuit of marginal gains. His ability to identify and exploit subtle advantages caught the attention of Trident, where he's been a valuable asset for the past five years. He prides himself on a data-driven approach, but isn't afraid to make bold calls based on instinct when the situation demands it. His colleagues know him as a calm and collected presence in the heat of a race, always ready with a calculated response. 

What sets Dimitrios apart is his knack for simplifying complex scenarios for the team. He has a unique ability to translate data insights into easily digestible information for the drivers and engineers, facilitating quick and effective decision-making.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Dimitrios has a focused look with a slightly stern expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking only herbal tea during race weekends.
